components: an upper-right loop returning left across the middle
strokeOrder: curl inward around the upper-left spiral — then lift once
set the pen at the middle and draw the central upright upward — then lift a second time
start at the top of the upright, sweep around the upper-right loop, and return left across the middle — then lift a third time
set the pen at the left end of the middle bar and circle the lower-left bowl back toward the centre — then lift a fourth time
set the pen at the centre, descend, and circle through the lower-right bowl
strokeOrderNote: five strokes — the upper-left spiral, central upright, upper-right loop with middle return, lower-left bowl, and lower-right bowl are separate pen-down runs; source-verified against the 13-frame Writing Tamil 10 animation and Radhakrishnan Appendix I Frame 11

strokeOrderSource.citation: Info-farmer, Writing Tamil 10.gif, ஐ stroke-order animation (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0, 2008), cross-checked with Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Appendix I Frame 11 (University of Texas at Austin), p. 194
strokeOrderSource.variation: The 13-frame animation writes five separate runs in order: upper-left spiral, upward central upright, upper-right loop returning left across the middle, lower-left bowl, then lower-right bowl. Radhakrishnan's Appendix I Frame 11 independently numbers the same shape as seven movements. This five-run learner path fits those movements to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline; Tamil handwriting varies by school.

notes: Independent ai begins words such as ஐந்து (aintu, five). The two lower bowls are written separately after the completed upper body.
